card.name: Missed doses and making them up
card.fires_on: Small words and verbs inside instructions about missed or delayed doses, such as "no need to" double, "catch up", "make up for". Also words about duration or gradual stopping.

modes.label: Make-up of missed dose
modes.description: Linking word or verb in a phrase saying not to double or catch up after a missed dose.
modes.example: If a dose of allopurinol tablets is missed, there is no need<< to>> double the dose at the next scheduled time

modes.label: Duration or gradual change
modes.description: Word in phrases about continuing for a set time or stopping gradually.
modes.example: Continue leucovorin until the methotrexate concentration has been maintained below the leucovorin rescue threshold<< for>> a minimum of 3 days.

card.writes: It adds words about schedule interruption, timing and stopping, such as interruptions, timed and Stopping.
card.plain: It fires on wording about what to do when a dose is missed or late, like not doubling up.
